fields.notes: The Avalon Interface Specifications define no protocol-level power states. Power management (clock gating, power domains) is an SoC / device concern; the Avalon Clock and Reset interfaces let a system be clock-gated or reset per domain, and Platform Designer generates clock-crossing bridges, but power intent itself is out of scope for the Avalon interface contract.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
